title: Registration Charges and Stamp Duty in Puducherry
description: How stamp duty and registration charges work on a property purchase near Pondicherry, why the two sides of the border differ, and how to get an exact figure.
h1: Property registration charges and stamp duty in Puducherry
lead: Stamp duty and registration charges are a real cost on top of the price. The exact figures change, so this guide explains how they work and where to get the current number.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: A purchase attracts stamp duty, which is a state or territory levy, and a registration fee. Both are generally calculated on the higher of the price in the deed and the government’s guideline value for the property. Read our guide on [guideline value](/guides/guideline-value-vs-market-value-puducherry) to see why that matters.

Land in Puducherry and land just across the border in Tamil Nadu follow different rules and rates, and these are revised from time to time. If you are comparing a plot in Puducherry with one near [Kottakuppam](/real-estate-kottakuppam), compare the total cost including registration, not only the price per sq ft.

Do not rely on an old blog post, including this one, for the rate. Ask the sub-registrar’s office, or check the registration department’s current notification, and ask your lawyer. We give buyers an estimate of the total cost before they commit.

bullets: Budget the registration cost separately from the price
Confirm whether any concession applies to the buyer, for example for women buyers, with the registration office
Keep the payment receipts: you need them later when selling

blocks.p: Tell us the property and budget. We will give you an estimate, including registration.
